bagPolicy.summary: All bags are subject to inspection at Summerfest, with no backpacks or bags larger than 9x10x12 inches allowed. Special considerations are made for parents with infants and those with medical needs.
prohibited: Cans and Glass/Plastic or Metal Containers
bagPolicy.note: Special consideration for parents with infants and those with medical needs. Nursing mothers may bring items in a separate bag.

parking.note: Patrons are encouraged to park in downtown Milwaukee parking structures and use Summerfest Shuttles for direct access to the festival. Shuttles run every 15 minutes from designated Park and Ride lots with a round-trip fare of $12 for adults and $6 for reduced fare riders.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Summerfest's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Summerfest 2025 introduces a diverse array of new food and beverage options, including unique items like Lumpia City Mac 'n Cheese Rolls and Funnel Cake Pork Sandwiches. The festival also highlights local vendors through the BMO Small Business Spotlight program.
stands: Select American Family Insurance Amphitheater Concession Areas

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Designated accessible parking spaces are located at the front Summerfest lots. Accessible parking spaces are available in Lot H.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Summerfest's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Summerfest. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Summerfest. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
